item.title: Iran conflict won’t trigger Biden-style refugee replay, expert predicts
item.summary: An immigration expert says Iran's instability is unlikely to trigger a Syrian- or Afghan-style refugee surge, as the Trump admin signals no intake plan.

item.title: House Homeland Security Republican urges US Muslim leadership to 'isolate extremists' after string of attacks
item.summary: GOP Rep. Andy Ogles of Tennessee issued an open letter in which he urged the American Muslim community to condemn recent terror attacks on U.S. soil.

item.title: Iranian man, 2nd person arrested after allegedly trying to enter UK nuclear missile base: report
item.summary: Authorities in the United Kingdom told Fox News Digital that two people were arrested after unsuccessfully attempting to enter HM Naval Base Clyde in Scotland.

item.title: Piers Morgan panel derails as far-left guest erupts over Iran war, slams Israel
item.summary: Cenk Uygur clashed with Piers Morgan and panelists during a heated debate over President Donald Trump, Israel and U.S. involvement in Iran on "Piers Morgan Uncensored."

item.title: DAVID MARCUS: The MAGA 'civil war' over Iran is a myth
item.summary: Polls show 83% of Republicans back Trump's Iran strikes, undermining media claims of a MAGA split over the conflict, according to L&V and Politico surveys.

item.title: Trump administration sues Harvard over alleged failure to protect Jewish and Israeli students, seeks billions
item.summary: The Trump administration is suing Harvard, alleging it failed to protect Jewish students from antisemitism and seeking billions in taxpayer funds back.

item.title: US intel softens on China threat, says no Taiwan invasion planned by 2027 despite military buildup
item.summary: The U.S. intelligence community says China has no fixed timeline to invade Taiwan and is not planning action by 2027, marking a shift from prior warnings.

item.title: Reporter's Notebook: GOP pushes election security bill despite slim odds, as Trump pressure looms
item.summary: Senate Republicans debate the SAVE America Act despite lacking votes, as Trump threatens to withhold endorsements from GOP members who oppose the bill.

item.title: Hospital cyberattacks threaten patient safety
item.summary: Medical data breaches expose patient records and Social Security numbers that cannot be replaced. Security expert Ricardo Amper provides essential steps for patients.

item.title: AI smart glasses could generate fake photos instantly
item.summary: Google, Meta, Samsung and Apple are developing AI-powered smart glasses that combine cameras and voice assistants to capture and immediately modify photos using generative AI.
